notes.title: v1.06
notes.notes:
Hey All,

In an effort to fix every minor thing we can as fast we can, we've uploaded yet another minor patch!

There was a bug which would not go to the stage select screen if you were on certain stages that has now been fixed!

notes.title: v1.05
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Just another round of fixes!

- minor bug fixes
- you can no longer open the menu while dead
- you will no longer be hit during boss events
- subtle changes to the dash mechanic to improve user control

notes.title: v1.03
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As some of you have noticed, a bug was introduced that sometimes occurred when you died and respawned during a boss fight. We apologize for this, as this happened as a result of an audio fix we did in v1.02, but the issue has been resolved in this update.

notes.title: v1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Hey All,

We've just posted v1.02 with a couple minor additions/fixes:

- Fixed an audio glitch that happened during the boss stages

- We've added a "credits" button to the main titles

- The artifacts you find will now properly reset to 0 when you start a new game (still does not reset on New Game+).

- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Viktor
notes.notes:
Viktor is Now Available on Steam!

Playing as Viktor, you will fight your way through a diverse spectrum of hostile environments filled with a wide variety of relentless enemies, lurking traps, and fearsome bosses who will try to keep you from your mission: finding Zane, defeating the merciless Mephistopheles, and restoring peace to Eos.
